title: GeoGulf 2027 — 76th GCAGS/GCSSEPM Convention and Exposition
description: GeoGulf 2027 is the 76th GCAGS/GCSSEPM Convention and Exposition, hosted by the Houston Geological Society and focused on Gulf Coast geoscience, petroleum systems, subsurface technology, CCUS, geothermal and related energy topics.

cfp.submission_guidelines: GeoGulf 2027 has an open call for abstracts with an official submission deadline of 1 December 2026.

program.overview: GeoGulf combines technical geoscience sessions with a convention exposition and Gulf Coast professional networking.

registration_fees.notes: Official registration listing includes technical sessions, exhibition floor and convention luncheons.

fees.pricing_text: Official GeoGulf registration publishes early-bird, standard and onsite conference rates.

community.overview: Hosted by the Houston Geological Society for Gulf Coast geoscientists, academics, energy professionals and technology providers.

title: Energy Opportunities Conference 2027
description: AAPG Energy Opportunities Conference 2027 returns to Cartagena during an active period for Colombia's exploration and production sector, connecting oil and gas, renewable energy, investment and technology decision-makers across Latin America.

program.overview: The 2027 event includes an executive programme, business-to-business sessions and an exhibition focused on technological advances and investment opportunities in Latin America and beyond.

venueInfo.accommodation: The conference is hosted at Hilton Cartagena on the Laguito Peninsula.

community.overview: Energy Opportunities connects senior decision-makers across oil and gas, renewables, finance, technology and regional business development.

title: MEOS GEO 2027
description: MEOS GEO 2027 is the Middle East's dedicated upstream oil, gas and geosciences conference and exhibition, connecting GCC operators, NOCs, IOCs, engineers, geoscientists, technology providers and decision-makers.

cfp.submission_guidelines: The MEOS GEO 2027 Call for Proposals is open for technical contributions to the conference programme.

program.overview: MEOS GEO combines strategic and peer-reviewed technical conference content shaped by SPE, AAPG, EAGE, SEG and regional experts, alongside the upstream exhibition.

venueInfo.accommodation: Official attendee information and conference planning resources are published by MEOS GEO.

community.overview: MEOS GEO brings together the full Middle East upstream value chain and reported 17,400+ visits, 3,124 conference participants and 732 speakers at its 2025 edition.

title: GEO4.0 Symposium 2027
description: GEO4.0 Symposium 2027 focuses on the digital future of geoscience, bringing together subsurface experts, innovators and technology leaders around AI, machine learning, intelligent workflows and emerging computational methods for energy geoscience.

cfp.submission_guidelines: The official GEO4.0 2027 Call for Abstracts is open for research, applications, case studies and new approaches across the technical programme.

program.overview: The symposium covers digitalization and intelligent geoscience across exploration and production, subsurface modelling, seismic imaging, decision intelligence, computational methods, climate and energy solutions and technology adoption.

community.overview: GEO4.0 is supported across the regional geoscience community and focuses on technical exchange, collaboration and digital transformation in geoscience.
